messages:
sre_maya: heads-up, blueharbor dedicated pool oscillating again — customers seeing intermittent 429s and latency spikes since 02:05 UTC. oncall alert: ASG scale up/down ~ 2m rhythm :eyes:

support_jen: ticket #54321 from CS — customer reports embed API calls fail with 429 during troughs. they attached request ids and a small repro script.

oncall_bot: [alert] dedicated-pool-blueharbor capacity-flap — scaled_replicas 2 -> 8 -> 3 in <5m. alert_id=cap-flap-7283. paging: @sre_maya @eng_carson

eng_carson: looking at grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/blueharbor/oscillation?panel=replicas — queue_length and replicas are in tight anti-phase. suspect metric noise + aggressive downscale.

sre_maya: snippet from autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:04:32Z scale: add 4 replicas reason=queue>threshold (qlen=72)
2026-03-17T02:05:12Z scale: remove 3 replicas reason=cpu<low (cpu=18%)
2026-03-17T02:06:40Z scale: add 3 replicas reason=queue>threshold (qlen=65)
```

eng_carson: cooldown is currently 300s but downscale logic allows partial removals and we have a short MA window (30s). small bursts push it up, then cpu/latency drops trigger partial downscale, creating sawtooth.

eng_carson: proposal: 1) increase downscale cooldown to 900s for pool-blueharbor only; 2) apply EWMA smoothing to queue metric (alpha=0.1); 3) enforce min_replicas=4; 4) add a 15s ignore window for spikes <10s; 5) add small random jitter (5-15s) before acting to break synchrony.

support_jen: customer impact? they are on dedicated with SLA. will they see higher cost if we raise min_replicas?

eng_carson: slight cost delta but should remove frequent 429s. we can do a scoped change just for their pool, not fleet-wide. if CS approves cost for >24h we'll keep; otherwise revert after stability verified.

sre_maya: plan to canary: patch staging autoscaler config, run traffic replay from repro script for 20m, then apply to prod pool-12 (blueharbor). rollback if no improvement.

eng_carson: runbook addition: if oscillation persists after config changes, switch customer to fixed_capacity mode (reserve N GPUs) for 24h and open billing exception.

sre_maya: kubectl command I'll run in staging in 30s:
```
kubectl patch configmap/autoscaler-blueharbor -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"downscaleCooldown":"900","minReplicas":"4","queueEWMAAlpha":"0.1","ignoreSpikeSecs":"10","decisionJitterSecs":"10"}}'
```

support_jen: tagging CS and finance for heads-up. I'll draft note about expected minor billing change and ask for OK to keep if stable.

sre_maya: applying patch to staging now...

oncall_bot: [run] configmap patch executed by sre_maya at 02:12:10 UTC. rollout: autoscaler-staging v2.1.4-canary

eng_carson: results from staging replay (20m): queue variance down 68%, replica churn reduced from avg 6 actions/10m -> 1 action/10m, 429s dropped to 0 in replay. nice.

sre_maya: canary to prod pool-12 scheduled in 5m. will monitor latency p50/p95 and 429 rate. alert thresholds lowered to catch regressions.

support_jen: emailed CS + finance with proposed change and canary window. CS says "please stabilize, keep us posted". finance asked for estimate, I gave conservative +3-6% for that pool.

eng_carson: small tweak post-canary: set downscale step to at-most 2 replicas per action to avoid big dips. add that to patch if canary looks good.

sre_maya: prod canary applied to pool-12 at 02:20:48 UTC. initial 15m look: replicas flapped once then settled. p50 latency improved ~120ms, p95 improved ~420ms, 429 count dropped from 18->2.

eng_carson: thumbs up. leave config for 2h observation, then if stable set to 24h retention and CS will decide on longer-term. open ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/54321 (internal link attached).

sre_maya: will add note to runbook and create follow-up RFC for smarter autoscale policies (pool-level EWMA tuning + tenant burst classification).

support_jen: closing loop with customer now. I'll update ticket and ask if they'd like us to keep min_replicas permanently.

sre_maya: closing this thread for now — monitoring until 04:30 UTC. will post final summary after observation window. :white_check_mark:
